description: This file contains shell functions for interacting with UBI volumes and device environment settings specific to the bcm4908 platform. It includes functions for reading firmware metadata, setting up environment configurations, verifying and managing the root filesystem data partition, and processing binary data from device nodes.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a specified file at a given offset and outputs the hexadecimal value in little-endian format.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration for UBI volume metadata, storing its location and size in /tmp/env.config.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the currently committed firmware image sequence number from UBI volume metadata.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies and optionally wipes the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume to match the current firmware image, marking it as ready.
